paragraphs: A sword with its scabbard is a more complete object than the blade alone. The sheath carries suspension rings for a baldric, a decorated throat and a chape at the tip, and the two together are how the weapon was actually worn and displayed rather than how it was used.

The mesh is light at 6,596 polygons and 6,851 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, and the texture set runs to 15 maps at 2048x2048 plus one more at the same size, carrying the steel, the leather and the bronze fittings.

At $29 it suits historical and museum visualisation, films and television set in antiquity, games, education material and reenactment reference. Real-world scale is kept, so it fits a figure at the belt. On sale since 2017.
